russia.homeSeoTitleZh: 俄罗斯公民来华签证政策｜免签、过境免签总览 2026
russia.homeSeoTitleEn: Russia citizens travel to China: visa & visa‑free overview 2026
russia.homeSeoDescZh: 俄罗斯公民前往中国可以享受单方面30天免签以及240小时过境免签，查看全部来华入境规则，材料、有效期、出行避坑与常见问题。
russia.homeSeoDescEn: Guide for Russian citizens travelling to China including unilateral visa‑free and 240‑hour transit visa‑free, documents, expiry, pitfalls and FAQs.
russia.homeIntroZh: 俄罗斯公民前往中国可以享受两套免签入境通道：单方面30天免签入境，适用于旅游、商务、探亲；同时支持240小时过境免签用于中转前往第三国。出行前请确认对应政策有效期，备好符合要求的护照与出行材料。
russia.homeIntroEn: Russian citizens have two visa‑free entry options for travelling to China: unilateral 30‑day visa‑free entry for tourism, business and family‑visit; and 240‑hour transit visa‑free for onward travel to third countries. Please check policy expiry and prepare valid travel documents before departure.
homeImportantNotesZh: 无论使用哪一种免签政策，护照建议预留6个月以上有效期以及足够空白签证页。
免签入境不允许从事工作、实习、留学、媒体采访等活动，此类情况需要提前申请签证。
抵达中国后，需要在24小时完成住宿登记，酒店一般会代办。
homeImportantNotesEn: Whichever visa‑free scheme you use, your passport is recommended to have more than 6‑month validity and enough blank pages.
Visa‑free entry cannot be used for work, internship, formal study or media reporting; a proper visa must be applied in advance for these purposes.
Accommodation registration must be completed within 24 hours after arriving in China, usually handled by hotels.

homeCustomFaqsZh.q: Q：俄罗斯公民去中国可以不用签证吗？
homeCustomFaqsZh.a: A：可以，普通护照可以享受单方面30天免签；中转过境还可以使用240小时过境免签。

homeCustomFaqsEn.q: Q: Do Russian citizens need a visa for China?
homeCustomFaqsEn.a: A: Ordinary passport holders can enjoy unilateral 30‑day visa‑free entry; you may also use 240‑hour transit visa‑free for connecting travel.

unilateral.customAlertZh: ⚠️政策有效期提醒：俄罗斯单方面免签政策有效期至2027‑12‑31，请留意政策到期更新。
unilateral.customAlertEn: ⚠️Policy expiry reminder: Russia unilateral visa‑free policy is valid until 31‑Dec‑2027. Please monitor official policy updates.
unilateral.extraIntroZh: 俄罗斯公民可享受中国单方面30天免签入境，仅限旅游、商务、探亲、过境。
unilateral.extraIntroEn: Russian citizens are eligible for China's unilateral 30‑day visa‑free entry for tourism, business, family‑visit and transit purposes.
unilateral.policyExplainZh: 中国对俄罗斯实施单方面免签政策，该政策由中国单方面给予俄方公民入境便利，并非双边互免协定。每次入境最长停留30天，停留时间从入境次日零时起算，目前无入境次数限制。政策存在有效期，到期后规则存在调整可能性。
unilateral.policyExplainEn: China implements unilateral visa‑free treatment for Russian citizens. This policy is offered unilaterally by China rather than a bilateral reciprocal agreement. Maximum stay is 30 days per entry counted from 00:00 next day of arrival. There is currently no entry‑count limit. The policy has an expiry date and may be adjusted in future.
tipsZh: 护照有效期建议大于6个月，备好往返机票预订单。
停留时间自入境次日零时起计算。
tipsEn: Passport validity is recommended to exceed 6 months; prepare round‑trip flight bookings.
The stay period counts from 00:00 the day after entry.
checklistZh: ✅确认护照有效期大于6个月，至少留有2页以上空白签证页
✅准备好往返或者后续离境的机票出票记录
✅完整覆盖全程的酒店预订单
✅准备少量资金证明以备边检抽查
checklistEn: ✅ Confirm passport validity >6 months with at least 2 blank visa pages
✅ Prepare confirmed round‑trip or onward flight tickets
✅ Complete hotel bookings covering your whole stay
✅ Prepare proof of funds for possible border inspection
pitfallsZh: ⚠️误区：拿到免签资格就一定可以入境。边检拥有最终入境审批权，材料不全有可能拒绝入境。
⚠️误区：免签入境不可以打工、做兼职或者参加付费实习，会造成违法滞留风险。
pitfallsEn: ⚠️Myth: Visa‑free eligibility guarantees entry. Border officials hold final decision‑making authority; incomplete documents may lead to refusal of entry.
⚠️Myth: You cannot take paid work, part‑time jobs or internships under visa‑free status, this will cause illegal‑stay risk.
afterEntryZh: 抵达之后24小时内完成住宿登记；入住酒店一般会自动代办；住民宿、私人住所需要本人前往辖区派出所办理。
免签一般不能境内延期；遇到重病等极端紧急情况，可以向当地出入境管理部门咨询停留证件申请。
afterEntryEn: Complete accommodation registration within 24 hours. Hotels usually handle it automatically; for private homestays you need to visit local police station in‑person.
Visa‑free stay normally cannot be extended inside China. In extreme emergency such as serious illness you may consult local immigration authority for stay permit.

customFaqsZh.q: Q：俄罗斯公民单方面免签入境中国可以多次入境吗？
customFaqsZh.a: A：可以，目前没有入境次数限制，但每次入境停留不能超过30天。

customFaqsEn.q: Q: Can Russian citizens enter China multiple times under unilateral visa‑free policy?
customFaqsEn.a: A: Yes. There is currently no entry‑count limit, but each stay cannot exceed 30 days.

unilateral.exclusionNoteZh: 单方面免签仅适用于普通护照；外交公务护照执行另外制度。
unilateral.exclusionNoteEn: Unilateral visa‑free applies only to ordinary passports; diplomatic / official passports follow separate regulations.

furtherReadingZh.title: 国家移民管理局官方公告

transit.customAlertZh: ⚠️过境免签提示：选择240小时过境免签，必须真正前往第三国，不能以单纯旅游作为入境目的。
transit.customAlertEn: ⚠️Transit visa‑free reminder: Under 240‑hour transit visa‑free scheme, you must actually travel onward to a third country; pure tourism is not accepted as entry purpose.
transit.extraIntroZh: 俄罗斯公民同时可适用240小时过境免签政策，最长停留10天。
transit.extraIntroEn: Russian citizens are also covered by the 240‑hour transit visa‑free scheme for maximum 10‑day stay.
transit.policyExplainZh: 240小时过境免签专为中转旅客设计，核心前提是必须持有已经确认的前往第三国/地区的联程机票，不适合纯粹来华旅游。允许在24个指定省份的开放口岸入境，并且在许可区域内跨省出行。
transit.policyExplainEn: The 240‑hour transit visa‑free scheme is designed for connecting transit passengers. Core requirement: you must hold confirmed onward ticket to a third country or region; it is not for pure tourism. You may enter via designated ports across 24 provinces and travel cross‑province within permitted zones.

mutual.customAlertZh: ⚠️重要特殊说明：根据双边协定，厄瓜多尔公民来华互免，但中国普通护照持有人暂不享受厄瓜多尔免签入境待遇。出行前请再次核实官方信息。
mutual.customAlertEn: ⚠️Important special note: Under bilateral agreement, Ecuadorian citizens enjoy visa‑free entry to China, but Chinese ordinary passport holders do NOT currently receive reciprocal visa‑free treatment. Please verify official information before travel.
